title: Law to require training for doctors on uterine fibroids
summary: This bill would require the city Health Department to develop and conduct trainings for health care providers on diagnosing and treating uterine fibroids, including on implicit bias and informed consent. The department would conduct outreach to inform providers of the trainings and could help incorporate them into Health and Hospitals Corporation professional development. The department must report annually on the trainings and the number of providers who completed them, starting within one year of the law taking effect.
